BiblicalUsage: Hazaiah is named in the list of the sons of Judah who dwell in Jerusalem after the return, the son of Adaiah in the line of Shiloni. He is named once, in the register of those who resettle the city.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts the resettlers of Jerusalem by name, and Hazaiah's single mention is the record of a family that came home.
